Data completeness: full months, real administrative boundary — 5526 recorded incidents total across 3 months (2026-04–2026-06), queried against Harrow's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for each month in that window. Day score: 2.313 weighted incidents/1,000 people, averaged over the last 3 months (92% of the 32-borough average). Night score: 10.73 weighted incidents/1,000 people, same window (88% of the 32-borough average). Both are normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population of 201,497 (2021 resident population of 261,200, scaled by a measured resident-vs-workday ratio from the ONS's 2011 Census release for Harrow — see methodology) rather than plain resident population, so central boroughs with heavy commuter/visitor footfall aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents. Rated against the average of the 32 boroughs currently on the automated pipeline.

Frequently asked questions

Is Harrow safe?

Based on real, current UK Police data, Wandroz rates Harrow as roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz at night, relative to the other London boroughs currently on the automated pipeline. The rating comes from 5526 recorded incidents over 3 months (2026-04 to 2026-06), split into a day-weighted score (property crime) and a night-weighted score (violence, robbery, antisocial behaviour).

Is Harrow safe at night?

Harrow's night score is roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz, based on the categories most relevant after dark (violence, robbery, street theft, public order, antisocial behaviour), normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population rather than plain residents where that data exists, so busy central boroughs aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents.

What official data is Harrow's rating based on?

5526 recorded incidents from data.police.uk (the UK Police's official open crime API), queried against Harrow's real administrative boundary and covering 3 months (2026-04 to 2026-06) — refreshed automatically every month, not a one-off snapshot. Full category breakdown is shown further down this page.
